title: Payment now commits before publication, with a remaining delivery gap
dek: A failed commit now prevents publication, while publication failure leaves a committed payment intact.
footer: The supplied code has no durable outbox or delivery deduplication.

sections.title: Publication used to precede commit
sections.content: The old callback marked the payment and published before the transaction committed. In the modeled commit failure, a notification escaped while the database write rolled back.

sections.title: Wait for the transaction to fulfill
sections.content: The changed function awaits the transaction before invoking publish. A write or commit rejection therefore prevents publication in that invocation.

sections.title: The database cannot roll back publication failures
sections.content: The author calls payment and notification atomic, but publish remains an external operation. Its rejection after commit leaves the payment recorded. It may also have delivered a notification before rejecting. The contract allows a process to stop between operations and supplies no durable retry. Concurrent invocations can each publish despite idempotent payment writes.

sections.title: Commit first, with a remaining delivery gap
sections.content: The change prevents publication before a failed commit. It does not make the committed payment and the external notification atomic.
